source: Every time the ride uses is here (DES-04, CR-29). build_method.py stamps this file into the page (#md-ride) so the page never fetches, and its --check fails a dwell under min_dwell_ms. TEST FLAG: opening the page with ?ridetest=<ms> (for example method/index.html?ridetest=300) replaces dwell_ms with that many ms, cuts orbit_ms and connector_ms to fit inside it, and multiplies speed_px_s by test_speed_mult, so a headless run reaches the Adopt chapter in about a minute. The flag is for tests; the min_dwell_ms rule does not apply to it. All times are milliseconds, all distances CSS pixels.
